name: Scholarly Discipline
body:
You have found similarities in your study of arcane schools and psionic disciplines, increasing your ability in both.

Prerequisite: Arcane school, discipline class feature.

Benefit: Your psion manifester level and wizard caster level gain a +2 bonus as long as this bonus doesn’t raise your manifester level or caster level above your current Hit Dice.
